record.title: Independent audit of P1.2 and P1.3

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Cleanup left tracked empty test stubs that were not executable tests.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: The repository appeared to provide future-phase coverage that did not exist.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Removed the six empty stubs and retained only executable current-phase tests in the migration manifest.

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Python bool values could pass integer metadata validation, and orientation products mixed squared geometric quantities with dimensionless tolerances.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: Malformed metadata could be accepted and geometric predicates had an unclear numerical threshold.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Reject bool-as-int values and compare orientation signs directly instead of multiplying dimensional quantities.
confirmed_findings_fixed.verification: Python compilation, regression suite, and diff check

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Angular error in radians was added directly to a metric capture distance.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: The numeric fixture passed while the calculation was dimensionally invalid.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Separated position_error_m from angular_error_rad and converted angular error through an explicit angular_reference_radius_m.

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Polygon validation accepted repeated non-closing vertices and did not reject self-intersection.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: Invalid obstacle or zone geometry could pass validation and reach downstream algorithms.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Require distinct vertices and reject non-adjacent segment intersections.

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Header validation did not reject INVALID records or future publication timestamps.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: Diagnostic/invalid or future-dated data could be treated as current input.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Reject INVALID records and publication timestamps beyond an explicit allowed_future_ns tolerance.

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: ContractHeader forced stage_id for all records, contrary to the specification allowance for sensor/diagnostic metadata.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: Valid pre-stage sensor records could be rejected or producers could invent authority metadata.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Allow empty stage_id in the value type; require it explicitly in authority validation with require_stage=True.

confirmed_findings_fixed.finding: Covariance validation accepted invalid dimension values and did not test the PSD boundary deeply.
confirmed_findings_fixed.impact: Malformed validator calls could silently accept empty structures.
confirmed_findings_fixed.fix: Require a positive integer dimension and add singular PSD and indefinite matrix fixtures.

false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.finding: The original bow-tie self-intersection fixture has zero signed area.
false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.result: It is correctly rejected as non-collinear before the simplicity check; this is not evidence that self-intersections are accepted.
false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.action: The adversarial test accepts the correct rejection category while separately exercising duplicate-vertex rejection.

false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.finding: The original capture interval test encoded a dimensionally invalid API name while expecting the correct numeric fixture.
false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.result: The test was a false positive for physical correctness.
false_positive_or_test_quality_findings.action: The API and test now make all metre/radian conversions explicit.

remaining_limitations.reason: Generated rosidl/colcon build still requires the pinned ROS 2 environment.
The pure validator uses fixed tolerances; production-scale coordinate bounds and exact robustness policy must be fixed before release.
validate_header validates one record; monotonic sequence and source-session cache policy belong to P1.5 adapters.
T07, full T20-T23 runtime lease behavior and T28 world/stage integration require later phase components.

verification.python_path_header_scan: All touched Python implementation and test files include a path comment on line 1
